basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Backend-Leaning Full-Stack Software Engineer · Go (Golang) · Python · React · 9,300★ Open-Source Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.rippling-backend-fullstack: Backend-leaning full-stack software engineer with 3.5+ years building scalable, distributed backend services in Go (Golang) and Python — including Kafka-based event-driven pipelines on AWS — plus production React experience shipping user-facing features and fixing component-lifecycle and rendering bugs. Built a Go/Gin REST API microservice at Turbot HQ (one of 120+ merged pull requests across its 9,300★ open-source suite) and led a 60+ file React user-upload workflow redesign at Trisetra.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal RESTful API microservice in Go (Golang) using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 (Auth0), containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, reasoning through fault-tolerance trade-offs: consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource, with a dead-letter queue (DLQ) added to capture recurring failures for manual investigation.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, Terraform-driven integration testing, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to an event-driven architecture via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90%.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries and data models powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% (cutting report generation from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes across 10,000+ resources).

Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) and extended the shared pipe-fittings Go library to ship HCL function-call support across two of them (a top-requested, reusable framework feature) — one of 120+ merged pull requests shipped through GitHub PR code review.

work.name: Trisetra, Inc.
highlights: Led the user-upload workflow redesign across 60+ files in React (Google Maps autocomplete, drag-and-drop upload, history dashboard, invite-code sign-up, improved empty/error states) — building and iterating on UI components — driving increased user engagement.

Built supporting 3D scene infrastructure in React — auto-crop image pipeline, IndexedDB-backed asset caching (fixing a recurring double-render bug), and bounding-box rotation control with surface-normal preservation across the scene graph.

Contributed to an incremental migration from React 17 to React 19 and MUI 4 to MUI 7, fixing component re-rendering issues in existing components; also authored a 3D-geometry library with the repo's first Mocha unit-test suite.
